text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Leaving her mark on the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn),
Nice Nature gained a little more 
confidence in herself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Hoping to take on the Arima Kinen, she 
decides to enter the Chunichi Shimbun Hai 
first to build up her confidence.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Nice Nature heads to the shopping
district 
after the Tenno Sho (Autumn), where she 
bumps into Tokai Teio.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
While acknowledging Nice Nature as a 
formidable rival, she provoked her, 
claiming Nice Nature could never beat her 
without giving it her absolute all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Swept along by the shopping district 
folks' enthusiasm,
Nice Nature impulsively 
blurted out, "I'll beat her!"
